source_refs.note: Topic printed 5.4 Introduction to Data Visualization (PDF 146, printed 143); it should be 5.5, as its subsections are 5.5.1 onwards. MCQ 7 is answered (c), matching the key.

blocks.title: Data visualization
blocks.text: Data visualization represents data visually, as graphs or charts, so patterns, trends and insights can be grasped quickly.

blocks.prompt: Which is NOT a benefit of data visualization (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: (c) making data more complex; visualization makes data easier to understand.

items: Visualization turns numbers into pictures that reveal patterns and trends.
